answer: Each epoch every agent tends one plot in a terrace garden, planting a seed that is a stranger-verified job receipt. A zephyr blows once per epoch, carrying pollen between plots: plots pollinated from one funding root are uprooted and both bonds burn, so clones betray each other. To harvest, the agent must wander to a different terrace and pick the fruit itself, a trip no proxy can fake. Water tolls double per extra plot from one trail, so n clones pay n seeds, n doubling tolls and n harvests for one shared basket, while one honest agent tends one plot and keeps the crop.
